name: semantic_transfer_validation_v1
objective: Validate frozen chat L28 against independently reviewed supplied-evidence semantics across expressions; then evaluate behavior regardless of probe hit.

source.selection: First30 sorted by SHA256(salt+|+original_id), before semantic inspection or any new probe output; no result-dependent replacement.
source.existing_val40_and_diagnostic_test300: Exploration only; not reused as new evaluation bases.

grouping: Every base question, source identity and all8 variants stay in one partition; never random-split variants.

construction.question: One question and scope fixed across all8 variants within a base; no gratuitous narrowing to manufacture unique roles.
construction.evidence: Five documents, fixed background multiset/slots per base. Both expression families realized for every semantic condition. No condition names or judgment metadata in model input.
construction.S: Two compatible support passages jointly establish every necessary premise.
construction.K: Different but jointly compatible supporting assertions (e.g. narrower/broader or complementary facts), retaining a complete answer. Explicit negative control for false conflict; no irrelevant conflict cue.
construction.I: Remove only one necessary premise under the matched template, without contradictory relevant claims or residual support in backgrounds. Do not assume a name establishes a relation.
construction.C: Same target/event/time/property with genuinely mutually exclusive claims; uniqueness/exclusivity only where warranted and constant across conditions. No supplied correction/source priority that resolves conflict.
construction.expression: Preserve evidence semantics within each condition across A/B; vary phrasing rather than question, slot or background. Record all edits and token deltas, without deleting premises to force length matching.
construction.counterfactual: If needed to obtain incompatible values, mark synthetic assertion explicitly in provenance; do not use world knowledge to score supplied-evidence truth.
construction.material_gate: Two independent-context input-only reviews before GPU; disagreements/ambiguity remain unknown, no automatic use of author condition as gold, no replacing bases after seeing outcomes. Nonconstructible bases remain recorded incomplete; analyze coverage, do not force labels.
construction.history_independence_gate: Input reviewers must not receive repository AGENTS.md/history, prior probe/behavior results or author labels. Existing40 background-exposed supplemental reviews do not satisfy this gate. Do not start new GPU before auditable material review is complete.

probe.frozen_old: Exact existing free-answer chat L28 scaler/router, unchanged; same already-verified interface, no repeat template-debug stage.
probe.semantic_retrain_trigger: On semantic_dev only: old-probe macroF1<0.75 OR sufficient(S/K)->conflict rate>0.20 OR A/B same-semantics label agreement<0.80. Unknown labels reported separately; cannot declare pass with semantic coverage<0.90.
probe.semantic_train_expression: A only, semantic_train12 bases x4conditions = at most48 examples; all B/train variants excluded from fitting.
probe.semantic_train_labels: Pre-GPU independent semantic review labels; unknown not used in fitting, counts retained; abort fit if any class absent.
probe.evaluation_lock: Hash final old-probe configuration and optional one-fit semantic probe before revealing semantic_eval predictions/reports; eval labels/review frozen before inference. No changes after eval disclosure.
probe.no_claim: Old and semantic-retrained probes reported separately. Training failure or unstable transfer is a result, not permission for another layer/fit/grid.

primary_evaluation.partition: semantic_eval12 bases x8variants = at most96 inputs; held out from new semantic-probe training and selection
old_probe_metrics: Accuracy and macroF1 on determinate labels with denominators
A/B same-semantics label agreement and both-correct fraction
Within-expression S->I and S->C both-correct transition fractions
All three probability deltas with token deltas
primary_evaluation.retrained_probe_metrics: Same frozen metrics and matched samples as old probe; A and B separate, plus grouped comparison. Never replace old-probe metrics with retrained scores.
primary_evaluation.agreement_warning: High A/B agreement with consistently wrong labels cannot establish reliability; report both-correct and false-conflict rates.
primary_evaluation.dependence: Bootstrap by base question only,10000 resamples; no treating variants or pair rows as independent bases. Small12-base uncertainty disclosed.
primary_evaluation.unknown_policy: All missing/unknown/unconstructible cells and semantic membership ambiguity reported with coverage and known-label denominators; no silent dropping or automatic refusal.

behavior.generation: Same frozen chat free-answer instruction, greedy128 tokens, no probe feedback. At most240 answers, one per material; final model/GPU protocol and timing pending prepared materials.
behavior.review: Separate fresh-context behavior reviewers see question/documents/answer, hidden probe and input review; no filtering by probe outcome.
behavior.primary_partition: semantic_eval; semantic_dev and semantic_train descriptive separately
primary_rates: All genuine semantic conflicts single-side selection
S and K grounded correct answering
S and K explicit erroneous insufficiency refusal
behavior.secondary: Probe-conditioned rates only descriptive with exact denominators; original1/2 never a main endpoint.
behavior.unknown: Preserve full eligible denominators with identification bounds; unknown input memberships additionally disclosed.

stop_rules: No extra wording candidates, layers or fits after inspecting evaluation results.
No original380 confirmation base inputs opened.
If reviewed semantic material or clean class support is inadequate, record incomplete measurement rather than enlarge the trial ad hoc.

decision_rules.result: Old probe fails, one-fit semantic probe generalizes across bases/expressions
decision_rules.next: Re-test signal-behavior relationship with reliable measurement.

decision_rules.result: Semantic probe remains unstable, behavior mismatch stable
decision_rules.next: Retain behavioral findings; narrow internal-recognition claims.

decision_rules.result: Semantic measurement and behavioral mismatch stable with clear matched contrasts
decision_rules.next: Consider separately frozen limited causal intervention with controls.

readiness: Design and base split only.240 texts, independent labels, GPU runnable implementation, tokenizer checks, timing and launch are not yet prepared. No claim of clean gold or confirmed reliability.
